system.description:
• Effect: Choose one invocation from the list in Eldritch Invocations, below.
  • Choose another at 4th, 6th, 9th and 15th level, on top of the two your Pact gives at 1st. When you gain a Warlock level you may swap one invocation for another.
  • You cannot take the same invocation twice.

activities.name: Fiendish Vigour
activities.text: After each long rest, gain temporary HP equal to your Warlock level.

options.name: Lance
options.text: A 60ft line, 5ft wide. (Shapes)

options.name: Burst
options.text: A 10ft radius on a point within 60ft. (Shapes, from 6th level)

options.name: Chain
options.text: The target and one more creature within 30ft of it; from 11th level, two more. (Shapes, from 6th level)

options.name: Long
options.text: Range 120ft, and the blast ignores half and three-quarters cover. (Shapes)

options.name: Agonising
options.text: The blast deals your Charisma modifier twice more damage, and the target takes full damage even if it saves. (Marks)

options.name: Repelling
options.text: A Large or smaller target is pushed 15ft away from you (in a Burst, away from its centre). (Marks)

rules.value: Repelling: a Large or smaller target that fails its save is pushed 15ft away from you (in a Burst, away from its centre).

options.name: Hellfire
options.text: It takes 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns (2d6 from 11th level). The fire ends when it or a creature beside it spends an action to put it out, or after 1 minute. (Marks)

options.name: Grasping
options.text: Its speed is 0 until the end of its next turn. (Marks)

options.name: Draining
options.text: You gain temporary HP equal to the damage dealt. (Marks)

options.name: Dread
options.text: It is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. (Marks)

options.name: Binding
options.text: Until the end of its next turn it can't teleport, turn invisible or change shape, and an invisible creature becomes visible. (Marks)

options.name: Withering
options.text: It has Disadvantage on its next save against one of your spells before the end of your next turn. This doesn't apply to a spell that kills outright. (Marks)

options.name: Armour of Shadows
options.text: +2 AC while you wear no armour and carry no shield (+3 from 10th level). Does not stack with Bracers of Defence or Mage Armour. (Defence and utility)

rules.when: while you wear no armour and carry no shield (doesn't stack with other unarmoured bonuses)

options.name: Fiendish Vigour
options.text: After each long rest you gain temporary HP equal to your Warlock level. (Defence and utility)

rules.value: Fiendish Vigour: after each full rest, temporary HP equal to your Warlock level.

options.name: Mask of Many Faces
options.text: Cast Change Self at will. (Defence and utility)

options.name: Devil's Sight
options.text: See normally in darkness, magical or otherwise, to 60ft. (Defence and utility)

options.name: Whispering Voice
options.text: Speak mind to mind with a creature within 30ft that shares a language with you, and you have Advantage on Deception and Intimidation checks. (Defence and utility)

options.name: One with Shadows
options.text: In dim light or darkness you are Invisible while you stay still; moving, attacking or casting ends it. (Defence and utility)

options.name: Servant's Vigour
options.text: Your summons gain temporary HP equal to your Warlock level and +1 AC. (Summons)

options.name: Shared Senses
options.text: You see and hear through your servant, and it can deliver your touch spells. (Summons)

options.name: Lasting Summons
options.text: Your combat summons last 10 minutes, and your ritual summons 8 hours. (Summons, from 6th level)

options.name: Servant's Fury
options.text: One of your servant's hits each round deals +1d6 damage of your Path's kind: Infernal fire, Abyss acid, Fey cold, Great Old One psychic. (Summons)

options.name: Living Shield
options.text: Once per round, out of turn, when you're hit while your servant is within 5ft of you, it takes the hit instead. (Summons)

options.name: Puppet's Path
options.text: As part of your movement, swap places with your servant within 30ft. (Summons)

options.name: Favoured Soul
options.text: One more Patron Favour a day. (Patron, from 9th level)

options.name: Thirsting Pact
options.text: Whenever Dark Harvest recovers a slot, you also regain 1 Patron Favour. (Patron, from 7th level)

options.name: Ward of the Patron
options.text: Once a day, when you drop to 0 HP, you drop to 1 instead, and your patron names a debt. (Patron, from 9th level)

options.name: Bound Armour
options.text: Bind one suit of armour during a long rest. You can don or doff it as part of any action. It counts as magical; if it has no bonus of its own, it gives +1 AC. While you wear it you're trained in heavy armour. (Blade)

options.name: Bound Weapon
options.text: Your pact weapon appears in your hand as part of any action. It counts as magical, can't be disarmed and vanishes when you let it go. (Blade)

options.name: Brand of Pursuit
options.text: Once per round, out of turn, when your branded foe moves away from you, move up to half your speed towards it; this movement provokes no Attacks of Opportunity. (Blade)

options.name: Life Drinker
options.text: Once per round, one weapon hit deals extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier. It is a flat bonus, not a rider. (Blade)

rules.value: Life Drinker: once per round, one weapon hit deals extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (flat, not a rider).

options.name: Shadow Lunge
options.text: Once per round, as part of your movement, teleport up to 15ft to a space you can see. Once per encounter, if you end beside your branded foe, your next attack on it this turn has Advantage. (Blade)

options.name: Fading Strike
options.text: Once per round, after you hit your branded foe, teleport up to 10ft; this movement provokes no Attacks of Opportunity. (Blade)

options.name: Warded Pact
options.text: While you carry a shield, +1 AC. Once per round, out of turn, when an ally within 5ft of you is hit, cut that hit's damage by your Charisma modifier. (Blade)

options.name: Accursed Challenge
options.text: When you Hex Brand a foe, it makes a Will save. On a failure it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you while you are within 30ft of it; it saves again at the end of each of its turns. (Blade)

options.name: Reaving Curse
options.text: While you wield a two-handed weapon, Hex Brand's extra die is 1d10. (Blade)

options.name: Hewing Strike
options.text: Once per round, when you drop a creature with a two-handed weapon, make one more attack against another creature in reach. (Blade)

options.name: Twin Fangs
options.text: While you fight with two weapons, your off-hand attack adds your Charisma modifier to damage. Eldritch Strike can ride it, still once a round. (Blade)
